summary: rhaap:launch-job-template launches an existing job template by name. Inputs: token and values.template (required), with optional overrides for inventory, credentials, extraVariables, limit, jobType (run/check), executionEnvironment, verbosity, forks (default 5), jobSliceCount, timeout (0 = none), diffMode, jobTags and skipTags.
questions: How do I run a job in check mode from a self-service template?
What is the default forks value for rhaap:launch-job-template?
How do I limit hosts when launching a job from Backstage?

answer_card.title: rhaap:launch-job-template inputs
answer_card.answer_md:
Required: `token`, `values.template` (job template name).

Optional overrides in `values`: `inventory`, `credentials` (array), `extraVariables`, `limit`, `jobType` (`run` or `check`), `executionEnvironment`, `verbosity`, `forks` (default 5), `jobSliceCount`, `timeout` (seconds, 0 = none), `diffMode`, `jobTags`, `skipTags`.
